accordion-description-content.text: Designed for the moments when skin looks depleted, this luminous treatment layers weightless moisture with a plush, velvety finish. It leaves a rested, candlelit look—never tacky, never overdone.

accordion-results-content.text: In a four-week consumer study, 92% agreed their skin looked more hydrated and 87% agreed skin felt visibly firmer and smoother. Individual results may vary.

accordion-shipping-content.text: Orders are prepared within 24 hours on business days. Enjoy complimentary standard delivery on orders above ₹3,500 and return unopened products within 30 days.

accordion-use-content.text: After cleansing, press 2–3 drops into damp skin morning and evening. Follow with moisturiser. In the daytime, finish with SPF.
